verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party docs say its AI assistant can read threads, search your entire email history and check your calendar, which covers the core of asking questions across inbox and calendar. Calendar access is also listed among the AI's connected apps, and the product identifies todos in the inbox, which partly speaks to 'what's outstanding'. A community note says free plans only index emails from the last 90 days before signup, which limits 'whole inbox' coverage on that tier. Missing for 10: documentation of grounded or cited answers (source links back to specific emails), hands-on corroboration of assistant answer quality, and full-history search on the free tier.
